Implementation candidate ready for independent final checking.

Candidate: `c57dfc70b6a1f2abdbefb31aa0c90ba4a6ce3c94`; base: `fd380aafe1df5a5379216d70c4fe4bfcf7f4b5db`; plan: `1`; issue input: `7cca95aedfcacb001beea343eb2952772f257aebc12db888a7ffcd474637248c`.

Independent unit checker accepted repaired candidate c57dfc70b6a1f2abdbefb31aa0c90ba4a6ce3c94 at base fd380aafe1df5a5379216d70c4fe4bfcf7f4b5db, plan1: all23 cases/10 mandatory unit gates passed; four Linux CPU matrices282/282 each, ASan+UBSan38/38 with effective instrumentation verified, eight concurrency cases repeated3times, four independently compiled mutations failed precise intended assertions and strict verifier passed. Original same-resource render-pass collision probe now passes; H19-TEXT-CF2-01 independently resolved with real enqueue grouping (two predicates/two APIs/two masks: two groups of four observations) and a collapse-only negative control. Support/dependency text is bounded to32 cause groups, eight global examples and42lines/32KiB per worker attempt, with explicit overflow/repeats/unknowns. Existing unrelated validation-policy/parser/driver output is outside this cap. Native Windows explicitly user-waived/unverified; no GPU, Steam, cache persistence or general binary ABI claim. Separate final checking remains required.

Source compare (branch will be published after final acceptance): https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/compare/master...codex/issue-19-support-dependencies
